description: Foundation: wire Tailwind v4 into Vite, overhaul global.css with new dark-first design system (CSS custom properties for indigo/purple accent palette, glassmorphism variables, @keyframes), create reusable primitives (Button, Card, Badge, SectionHeader, AnimatedSection), create hooks (useIntersectionObserver, useScrollSpy), create MainLayout, and create the src/sections/ directory by moving section files there. This feat leaves all section JSX logic unchanged — only moves files and establishes the design foundation and directory structure that FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on.
steps: Step 1 — Wire Tailwind v4: Edit frontend/vite.config.js to import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite' and add it to the plugins array: `import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite'; plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()]`. This enables Tailwind utility classes in JSX.

Step 2 — Replace src/styles/global.css entirely: Start with `@import 'tailwindcss';` (Tailwind v4 syntax — NOT @tailwind directives). Then define CSS custom properties in :root with the new dark-first indigo/purple palette: --bg-main: #0a0a0f; --bg-surface: #0f0f1a; --bg-surface-elevated: #141425; --bg-glass: rgba(20, 20, 37, 0.7); --border-glass: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); --border-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); --accent-primary: #6366f1; --accent-secondary: #8b5cf6; --accent-cyan: #06b6d4; --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6); --text-main: #f8fafc; --text-muted: #94a3b8; --text-subtle: #64748b; --primary-glow: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25); --nav-bg: rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.85); --card-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); --card-shadow-hover: 0 20px 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.2). Define html.dark aliases pointing to same values (dark is the default). Define light theme overrides under :root[data-theme='light']. Define @keyframes: fadeInUp (from opacity:0 translateY(20px) to opacity:1 translateY(0)), slideDown (for mobile drawer), pulseGlow (for availability dot), gradientShift (for hero bg blob). Define utility classes: .glass-card (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg, border-glass border), .gradient-text (bg-clip-text transparent with accent-gradient), .section-container (max-w 1200px, mx auto, px-5), .section-padding (py-20 at min). Preserve all existing CSS class names so no existing JSX breaks — add new classes alongside old ones. The existing dark-theme variables like --primary, --bg-surface etc. must be updated to the new indigo palette values (--primary becomes #6366f1 in dark, etc). Keep all scrollbar styles, .btn variants, .modern-navbar, .hero-section, .timeline-*, .modal-*, .form-field, .alert-box classes — update their color references to use the new CSS variables.

Step 3 — Create src/components/Button.jsx: Reusable button primitive. Props: variant ('primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'ghost'), size ('sm'|'md'|'lg'), children, className, ...rest. 'primary' variant renders with gradient background via inline style (background: 'var(--accent-gradient)'). 'outline' variant renders with border of --accent-primary color. All variants have hover:scale-[1.02] transition. Export named Button.
Step 4 — Create src/components/Card.jsx: Wrapper div with glass-card class + rounded-2xl + optional hover:border-indigo-500/30 transition. Props: children, className, hover (bool). Export named Card.

Step 5 — Create src/components/Badge.jsx: Small pill component. Props: children, color ('indigo'|'cyan'|'emerald'|'purple'|'amber'), className. Renders a span with appropriate background-opacity color and border. Export named Badge.

Step 6 — Create src/components/SectionHeader.jsx: Renders the standard badge + h2 title + subtitle pattern used in every section. Props: badge, title, subtitle, centered (bool). Uses gradient-text class on the title. Export named SectionHeader.

Step 7 — Create src/components/AnimatedSection.jsx: Wrapper that uses IntersectionObserver to add a 'visible' class when the element enters the viewport, triggering the fadeInUp @keyframe. Props: children, className, delay (number, ms). Uses useRef and useEffect internally (no external hook needed for this component). Export default AnimatedSection.

Step 8 — Create src/hooks/useIntersectionObserver.js: Custom hook. Accepts (ref, options = { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px' }). Returns isVisible (boolean). Uses IntersectionObserver API; cleans up on unmount. Export default useIntersectionObserver.

Step 9 — Create src/hooks/useScrollSpy.js: Custom hook. Accepts (sectionIds: string[], offset: number = 80). Returns activeSection (string). Listens to window scroll, checks each section's offsetTop against scrollY+offset, returns the matching id. Export default useScrollSpy.

Step 10 — Create src/layouts/MainLayout.jsx: Wraps children between and
. Imports Navbar from '../components/Navbar' and Footer from '../components/Footer'. Renders:
{children}
. Export default MainLayout.

Step 11 — Create src/sections/ directory and move section files: Copy (do not delete yet) the logic of these 7 components into new files at src/sections/: Hero.jsx, About.jsx, TechStack.jsx (rename to Skills.jsx in sections/), Experience.jsx, Education.jsx, Projects.jsx, Contact.jsx. These section files will be RESTYLE targets in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003. For now simply copy them verbatim with updated import paths (replace '../components/' prefixes with '../components/' where needed, and '../data/' and '../assets/' etc. keep the same relative paths adjusted for the new location). Also copy ProjectModal.jsx to src/sections/ProjectModal.jsx.

Step 12 — Update src/App.jsx: Change imports to point to src/sections/ instead of src/components/ for Hero, About, TechStack (as Skills), Experience, Projects, Education, Contact. Keep Navbar and Footer from src/components/. Keep id='home' on Hero section, id='about' on About section, etc. The skills section id should remain 'skills' to not break scroll spy.

Step 13 — Update src/pages/Home.jsx, src/pages/About.jsx, src/pages/Contact.jsx, src/pages/Services.jsx, src/pages/Login.jsx, src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: Pages that import Navbar/Footer directly from components/ can optionally wrap in MainLayout — but to avoid breaking changes, just keep their existing Navbar/Footer imports intact. Services.jsx imports '../components/Skills' — keep that import since src/components/Skills.jsx still exists.

Step 14 — Update src/index.css: Remove body font-family override (Times New Roman) and background:#f4f7fb. Remove the #root width:1126px constraint and border-inline (this restricts the layout). Set body to use var(--bg-main) background. Keep the rest as fallback.

Step 15 — Update src/App.css: Remove all the manual CSS overrides (Times New Roman fonts, blue border-left on cards, old hero styles, p text-align:justify rules) since these conflict with the new design. Either clear the file entirely or keep only the bare minimum.
Step 16 — Update index.html: Change <title> from 'frontend' to 'Selamsew Alemu — Computer Engineer & Full-Stack Developer'. Add <meta name='description'> for SEO.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with zero errors after all FEAT-001 changes
The vite.config.js contains the tailwindcss plugin import
src/components/Button.jsx, Card.jsx, Badge.jsx, SectionHeader.jsx, AnimatedSection.jsx exist and export their named/default exports
src/hooks/useIntersectionObserver.js and useScrollSpy.js exist and export defaults
src/layouts/MainLayout.jsx exists and renders children between Navbar and Footer
src/sections/ directory contains Hero.jsx, About.jsx, Skills.jsx (was TechStack), Experience.jsx, Education.jsx, Projects.jsx, Contact.jsx, ProjectModal.jsx
The home page renders without console import errors
findings: All 16 steps implemented successfully. Build passes cleanly (zero errors, zero warnings) at 827ms. Key decisions: (1) Google Fonts @import placed before @import 'tailwindcss' to satisfy CSS spec ordering requirement. (2) src/sections/Skills.jsx is the renamed copy of TechStack.jsx — the original src/components/TechStack.jsx is preserved so pages/Services.jsx and other references remain unbroken. (3) App.jsx now uses Skills (not TechStack) from sections/. (4) index.css and App.css cleared of conflicting overrides (Times New Roman, #root width constraint, border-inline). (5) All new CSS variables use the indigo/purple dark-first palette with --accent-gradient, --bg-glass, --border-glass, and glassmorphism utility classes (.glass-card, .gradient-text). (6) All existing class names preserved for zero JSX breakage.
